name: Mom
message: This trail magic is so amazing! People really can be wonderful. I hope they know how thankful we are for them.

name: Pablo
message: So thankful for trail magic, specially the one by Horsepower's family.

name: Lynn Kajzer
message: I love checking in and living vicariously through your adventures. Just watched a you-tube video of a 91 year-old called “gray beard” who is hiking the trail for the 2nd time in his life. He is trying to reset his own record as the oldest person ever to hike the entire trail. He currently has 300 miles left and allowed himself a full year to Complete it. (He set out Sept 25, 2025). If you meet up with him, be sure to get a photo with him. So proud of you!
